snippet.title: KuloNiku: Bowl Up! | Launch Date Announcement!
snippet.description:
Prep your stations for a management-sim cooking game with attitude - Coming to Steam on April 7th! Wishlist KuloNiku: Bowl Up on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3357960/KuloNiku_Bowl_Up/

 Utilize long-honed recipes as you prepare unique meals for quirky small-town locals, upgrade and customize your shop, compete in thrilling cooking battles to become top chef, and protect your family’s long-running restaurant!
